summary: Project to ensure Forge-uploaded NFT images are processed with Pixel Mode + configured Dimensions and the processed result is what gets uploaded to Pinata (discarding originals).
architectural_notes: Pinata upload pipeline must upload the post-processed image blob (Pixel Mode + configured Dimensions), not the original upload; original can be discarded after processing.
known_issues: Forge uploads: Pinata receives original image dimensions instead of the processed (Pixel Mode + configured Dimensions) version shown in-app.

existing_features.title: Ensure Forge “Direct Injection” image uploads are processed into a new square PNG at the project’s configured output dimensions before being saved into project state (so the stored image matches what the app displays). Processing must: (1) resize to exactly project.settings.outputSize x project.settings.outputSize, and (2) apply pixel mode by disabling canvas image smoothing when project.pixelArtMode is enabled.

Discard the original, unprocessed uploaded file once processing is complete: do not persist original dimensions or original image bytes in project.customTokens or any other long-lived project state used for export/upload.

Verify the IPFS/Pinata upload pipeline uses the processed images for any NFTs originating from Forge uploads by ensuring the imageData that flows into uploadCollectionToIPFS (project.generatedNFTs[*].imageData) is the processed Forge output rather than the original upload data URL.

new_feature_requests.summary: Upload to Pinata should use the processed (Pixel Mode + configured Dimensions) image for Forge uploads; discard original after processing

projectName: Upload processed Forge images to Pinata (pixel mode + configured dimensions)
